firewalld uses the concepts of zones, policies, and services to simplify traffic management. Zones
logically separate a network. Network interfaces and sources can be assigned to a zone. Policies are
used to deny or allow traffic flowing between zones. Firewall services are predefined rules that cover all
necessary settings to allow incoming traffic for a specific service, and they apply within a zone.
